general: Wilyador starts wounded and takes 2 damage each round end. Race.
Only Eagles and ranged characters can attack or defend the bats and flock.
An undefended attack's shadow moves the damage to Wilyador.
Swarming Insects spares anyone with an attachment - spread them out.

1: No travel to Rhosgobel until stage 1 ends; from staging it blocks healing.
2: Peeking at the encounter deck costs Wilyador 1 damage per player. Skip it.
Cards that heal Wilyador leave the game here. Bring several copies.
3: Each Athelas heals 5. Advance with Wilyador wounded and you lose.

general: Never take the Ringwraith option - stage 3 drags every Nazgul back.
Keep the One Ring ready: exhaust it and the Witch-king engages at 15.
Under 35 threat you face the Nazgul one at a time.
Weather Hills puts a non-unique enemy out of play. Hide a Nazgul to win.

1: Bill Ferny can't be optionally engaged at 38. Shoot him from staging.
The Pony blocks advancing; exploring it drops 1 enemy per player.
2: Lose 1 progress per player each round unless you take a Ringwraith.
Travel to Midgewater: unengages everything, freezes combat. Time it.
3: No quest points. Win by killing every Nazgul in play.
Witch-king needs 14 attack. 1-willpower characters can't defend him.

general: Hold willpower for Hide tests. A fail engages every staged Nazgul.
Under 35 threat you choose when to face a Black Rider.
Have You Seen Baggins? discards its hero on your next failed Hide test.
Black Riders refuse non-Morgul attachments. Leave traps at home.

1: Bag End must be explored to leave - just 4 progress. Stall and build.
2: Each ally adds 1 to your Hide test threat. Go tall, not wide.
14 points and a fresh Black Rider on entry. Blitz it in one round.
3: Pass a Hide test: 2 progress per player on a non-unique location.
Clear other locations, pass a Hide 3, explore the Ferry's 9 to win.

general: Stay on-course: off-course kills warship bonuses and wakes Ramming Speed!
Worst heading drops Raider Flagship's engagement cost 50 - it comes for you.
Kill Siege Ships fast - each re-guards a freed objective every quest phase.
Only Ship objectives can attack the Flagship. Build Dol Amroth Warships.

1: On-course, an engaging Ship takes 2 damage. Off-course, your own ship does.
2: No advancing while any objective is guarded. Free them all first.
3: Advancing checks engagement against all of staging, Flagship included.
Each Ship enemy in play adds 5 quest points. Clear the bay first.

general: Heal up. Trolls, treacheries and stage 3 punish damaged characters.
No Ent decks: self-damage feeds Savage Trollspawn and locks out Goblin Pursuer.
Lose Amarthiul and you lose. He moves to whoever gets engaged - armour him.
Don't chump the Cruel Mountain-troll: excess damage strips every quest's progress.

1: Quest against side quests - each explored pours its points here.
2: An active safe location stops the extra encounter card each quest phase.
3: Off safe ground damaged characters lose 2 willpower. Soak hits on non-questers.

general: Fewer different card costs in your deck, less healing for the Ringleader.
Ringleader: 10 hit points, capped at 5 damage a round. Two clean rounds.
Every kill feeds Plundered Goods: 1 staging threat per card it holds.
Kill staging enemies before they loot: non-uniques have 4 hit points max.

1: Stage 1 advances on kills, not progress: 1 + 2 per player.
Stage 1 progress is lost on advance - spend it 5 at a time on loot piles.
2: Keep questing at stage 2: 5 progress buys back a looted card, free to play.
Enemies here engage the moment they enter play. No warning.

general: No progress needed - hold every Osgiliath location at end of round.
A landed attack returns your held location to staging. Defend all.
Southron Commander only hits location holders. Pool them on one player.
You pick the setup enemy. Uruk Lieutenant wastes its When Revealed.

1: Ruined Square bounces back when a character leaves play. No chumping.
Active location: West Quarter quests on defence, East Quarter on attack.

general: Kills and explored locations drop city strength. At 0 the Lieutenants can die.
Each progress on your stage 3 cuts 1 from its Lieutenant's engagement cost.
Dol Guldur locations take progress only at their matching stage 3. Else, discard tech.
Much of the deck strips quest progress. Feint and early kills protect it.

1: Three rounds. Progress banks onto Power of Lorien: 10 buys the Host, 30 keeps both.
2: Host of Lorien: 10 progress, quests without exhausting, defends across the table.
3: Spend 5 progress a round or eat the penalty. 5 more buys the bonus.
Progress wipes every round as you rotate stage 3, and an unused one fires too.

general: Off Track means no main-quest progress. Travel and resolve Track to flip back.
Off Track rounds are free building time - run side quests.
Failing a quest flips you Off Track. Never commit to one you might lose.
On Track sharpens every spider. Flip, push 5 progress, advance.

1: Setup adds a location per player. Bring location control.
2: On Track here, cancels do nothing. Save A Test of Will for 3.
Off Track, Hive Guardians are weakest. Clear them now.
3: Brood Mother resists damage until 5 progress sit here. Off Track wipes it.
A Broodling joins every round. Once she can be hurt, ignore them.

general: No engaging on stage 1; every engagement cost drops to 0 on stage 2.
Bring healing: 2 Uruk types have Archery, Sarn Gebir burns the exhausted.
Uruk-hai Captain can't be chumped - allies under 3 hit points can't defend.
Fallen into Evil turns a hero into an enemy. Pack condition removal.

1: Sarn Gebir blocks The Argonath, which blocks advancing. Clear in order.
Enemies can't be engaged and get +2 defense. Quest through the threat.
2: Every engagement cost hits 0 for one phase. Hold defenders back first.
Split the staging area card by card. Each location to whoever can clear it.
3: Progress discards encounter cards. Quest hard to dig out Frodo's Choice.
4: Parth Galen is immune and blocks the win. Travelling there adds an enemy.
1 extra encounter card per player each quest phase. Back this player.

general: Cards under The Orcs' Search raise each player's threat every round.
A location goes under the Search at damage equal to its quest points.
The Secret Chamber can take 6 damage before you lose.
Put the Mould on a hero who will live. If they leave play, you lose.

1: Traveling to The Secret Chamber costs 3 quest progress. Budget 17, not 14.
No advance until a hero holds the Mould. Explore The Secret Chamber.
2: Arriving fires every Scour; Bellach hits the Mould's holder for 5. Defend it.
Bellach is untouchable until 12 progress on the stage. Quest, then kill.

general: Wainriders advance each quest phase by the threat of staging enemies. Clear them.
Wainrider Champion cannot be killed or removed, and engages all when you are level.
Each stage cleared in a round adds a required result to later tests. Don't sprint.
With Narrow Pass active, damage to the Champion comes off the Wainriders' stage.

1: Failing this defense test costs a random card. Save the defender for the Champion.
2: Failure damages every character. Pass this attack test or clear 1 hit point allies.
3: TURN is much rarer than STRAIGHT. Commit big willpower or lose an ally each.
4: Failure reveals one extra card, two at 3+ players. Cheap to eat.
5: Failure feeds the Wainriders: 2 damage per player on their stage. Pass it.
6: Fail and the stage stands, all progress lost. Best attacker on this TURN test.

general: Bring condition removal: Sacked! can't be canceled, Roasted Slowly kills its hero.
All four unique Trolls engage at 34. Stay under it - one at a time.
Rupert first - he returns Sacked! to the deck. Then Louis: +3 threat per Troll attack.
Travel to Bee Pastures, then pay 8 leadership resources to gain Grimbeorn.

1: Only 7 progress - don't rush. Build a defender who survives 4 attack.
The 7th progress activates The Carrock: every Troll gets +1 attack and defense.
2: One quest point, but it won't clear until all four Trolls are dead.

general: Never discard a set-aside enemy - it returns at stage 4.
The Black Serpent can't be damaged or drawn out. Budget its tax.
Both locations pull set-aside cards on arrival. Chip them in staging.
Setup is random. Cover questing, combat, healing, threat and locations.

1: One planning phase only, and allies arrive exhausted.
2: Every ally played is taxed. Favour a few strong over a swarm.
3: Every stage 3 punishes engaging - damage, progress or threat. Time it.
Under Orc Patrols each staging enemy adds 2 quest points. Engage first.
4: Chumping costs progress equal to the attacker's printed threat.
Lose Poros Garrison, lose the game - no player card can protect it.

general: Stall at stage 1. Advancing adds a Plot objective and a card per player.
Cultists are immune to player card effects. Raw attack only.
Secret Cultist turns your highest-attack ally on you. Gandalf invites it.
Bring threat reduction. Hillside Manor caps it at 1 a round in staging.

1: Last safe stage. Prep here. Needs 5 progress and 2 explored locations.
2: Needs 3 resources plus one per player, each with a free encounter card.
3: Cultist damage caps each round at the active location's printed quest points.

general: Running out of deck eliminates you. Bring recursion and a thicker deck.
Everyone starts engaged with a Baleful Shade. Have a defender ready.
Losing Iarion loses the game. Protect him like a hero.
Heavy Curse taxes any card whose twin sits in your discard pile.

1: Clear staging first - stage 2 adds Thaurdir plus a card per player.
2: Sorcery heals Thaurdir 3 and gives a free attack. Quest out the 13 first.
Thaurdir is indestructible - take his last hit points in one swing.

general: 60 degrees loses. From 10 at +4 a round, 11 rounds for 38 quest points.
Bring healing. Heat chews hit points and enemies hunt damaged characters.
Locations bite on becoming active, and travel is free. Explore from staging.
Heat stacks: Burnt Sands, Scorching Sun, every advance. Skip what you can.

1: Allies arrive exhausted or damaged here. Get them down early.
2: Don't camp. Each round deals damage equal to the heat's tens digit.
3: Bring a Were-worm in alive - one in play is one the stage can't pull.
Heat now adds staging threat too. Quest big or not at all.

general: Bilbo has 3 hit points. His death ends the game; failed riddles hit him.
Riddles read your deck. One sphere and tight costs make guesses land.
Every enemy but Gollum engages at 30 or less. Expect a swarm.
Stage 1 reveals an extra card per player. Board control beats willpower.

1: No stage 3 until the riddles finish. Fill this stage and use the wait.
2: Only riddle answers move this stage. Nine progress; your deck decides.
3: Treacheries all surge now, and Gollum's undefended damage hits Bilbo.

general: Explore locations to rescue villagers. Location control is the score.
Ghulat hits for the dead villager count, +1 per attack. Keep it at 0.
Exhaust Alcaron to save a discarded villager. Ready him; his death loses.
You score rescued against dead. Cancel the villager-discard treacheries.

1: Each progress rescues a villager. Burning Farmhouse loses one a round.
2: Undefended attacks kill villagers, not heroes. No ending while Ghulat lives.

general: Stages 1-2: one ally per round for the whole group. No swarm decks.
Go mono-sphere - a random hero starts imprisoned.
The Nazgul blocks attachments only. Direct damage and cancellation work.
Keep allies alive to feed the Nazgul's attacks.

1: A random hero is captured. Hold 1 objective card to advance.
2: 15 points. No advance until the prisoner and all 3 objectives are yours.
3: An Orc Guard per player each quest phase. Kill the Nazgul or it never ends.

general: Chumping the Balrog heals it 2 and costs 2 threat. Defend 8 attack instead.
Which stage 2 and final you draw is random. Bring willpower and attack.
Dark Pit needs 1 progress; the price is its travel cost. Set up first.
Stage 3 adds nothing but the Balrog. Arrive with staging clean.

1: Dark Pit must go before this stage ends, and travel there costs an uncancellable card.
2: One of three: an immune enemy blocking progress, a 1-card hand, or 20 points with forced travel.
3: On the Bridge, undefended and excess Balrog damage hits the quest card. Enough loses.
On Last Lord of Moria, the Balrog's damage cap per round is this stage's progress.

general: You open with 1 hero, 3 cards, 2 resources. Pick one who can quest.
Threat starts at that hero's cost, so secrecy is live from turn one.
Direct damage shines - most Mount Gram enemies have 2-3 hit points.
Travel to Southern Gate: everyone hits 35 threat, Orcs get +2 attack.

2: Progress rescues captured cards at random. Quest until the pile is empty.
3: 14 progress unlocks Southern Gate; explore its 8 points to win.
Kill Jailor Gornakh early - each rescue has him engage and attack highest threat.

general: End a round with no quest progress and "Seize them!" loses the game.
Chumping removes progress equal to the attacker's threat. Defend properly.
Both stages cap at 15 progress and won't clear while anyone is engaged.
Narrow Alleyway puts an engaged enemy out of play - the cleanest answer.

1: You each start engaged with an Umbar Sentry. Clear it before advancing.
2: Advancing pulls a fresh enemy onto each player. Be ready.
Nobody engaged at the quest phase adds an enemy. Keep one around.

general: Dagnir's 20 hit points win it. The hill's 50 progress is never needed.
50 damage on Hrogar's Hill loses. That, not questing, is your clock.
Dagnir takes 1 damage a round, plus 1 per banked side quest. Bank more.
At 3 side quests banked she engages everyone. Have defenders and healing.

1: Each planning phase adds a side quest and a Dagnir swing at the hill. Defend it.

general: Every spider has Venom. Prevent attacks instead of scrubbing poison.
Fat Spider swings 4 instead of 1 at a player with a poisoned character.
Exploring Forest Stream sheds 4 poison. While active it blocks poisoned questers.
Bring shadow cancellation. Spider shadows poison and can drop a defender.

1: Stage 3 wipes hero resources. Save the Ring's action for after the wipe.
True solo: stage 2 discards the old staging area. Park enemies there first.
3: Only Bilbo acts. Two Baggins resources wake a defender or a quester.
4: The Spider's Glade blocks progress and adds a spider each quest phase.

general: Nameless Fear's threat, attack and defense equal your victory points. Stages feed it.
A Foe Beyond hits a hero for the Balrog's attack, uncancellable. Bring hit points.
You commit before the stage flips. Keep willpower you can add after.
Bypass stage cards at end of combat until Abandoned Tools appears, then dig out.

1: Stage 1 banks 2 victory points - the Balrog opens at 2 attack, 2 defense.
2: Only 2 of 7 exits win: Blocked by Shadow at 9 points, Escape from Darkness at 4.
Only Abandoned Tools progresses Escape from Darkness - Narrow Paths fetches it.

general: Two wins: outquest the Stormcaller, or sink it. Both need willpower.
Failed sailing tests hand it the lead. Scry, and commit enough.
Park a treachery on top of the deck to slow its progress.
Location control frees progress for the main stage.

1: End the quest phase off-course and it takes 2 of your progress.
2: Progress caps 8/round, 4 off-course. Damage on it caps at 4.
3: Off-course costs an extra encounter card. Damage caps at 8.
4: Weather treacheries damage every ship here - enemies too.

general: The Ring-bearer's 15 life is the clock - it drops 1 every round.
Never defend with the Ring-bearer. Evil Wound turns damage into lost life.
Each staged Fell Rider costs 1 life or a forced engagement per round.
Progress on Ettenmoors costs 1 Ring-bearer life. Clear elsewhere first.

1: The Last Bridge must reach the victory display: budget 19 progress, not 15.
2: 15 points becomes 30 while any Nazgul is in play.
Ford of Bruinen discards every engaged enemy when explored. Engage first.

general: Nothing strips attachments here - load your heroes. Allies keep getting taken.
Spend every round. Chill Fog discards all resources, +1 threat each.
Condition removal for Dreadful Song; threat reduction for 2B's +1 a round.
Kill wights the round you engage them - each shuts something off.

1: Free round: no quest phase. Ancient Barrow takes an ally each - buy attachments.
2: Don't rush. Stage 3 punishes a weak board.
Hollow Circle hands each player a wight. Travel only when you can kill it.
3: Great Barrow blocks all progress, drags its finder to stage 4 alone. Five in deck.
Any elimination is +10 threat to everyone still here. Leave nobody behind.
4: 4A keeps only as many allies as you have engaged enemies. Plan ahead.
Defend for real in the barrow - no North Downs in your staging area.

general: Leave card draw at home. Hand size powers most enemies and treacheries.
Under 35 threat keeps the Dunland Raider and Chieftain off you.
If Grima leaves play you lose. Never risk him on defense.
Ill Tidings sticks in the first player's hand, inflating hand-size effects.

1: 5 time counters, then Grima is discarded and you lose. Clear The Islet.
2: Every second round you take damage equal to your hand. Empty it.
3: No defeating this stage with any enemy in play. Clear the board.
Timer discards cards equal to the first player's hand; enemies join staging.

general: Rush stages 1 and 2 - discarded enemies and treacheries return in stage 3.
Nameless Things take attack and hit points from milled cards - keep costs low.
Only ranged characters can attack or defend Moria Bats.
Hold Item, Armor, Weapon and Light attachments - stage 3 discards them all.

1: Cave Torch is Light: stage 3 takes it. Spend it freely first.
2: Everyone who commits mills 2 cards. Don't linger over 12 points.
3: No progress needed: strips your gear, wipes the board, splits the party.
4: You're alone in your own staging area until progress rejoins you.
5: You cannot commit more allies than heroes. Send the heroes in.

general: Defense inverts questing: stop progress, don't place it.
Win on 8 counters on The Defense of Helm's Deep, not progress.
Low threat wins here - pick your engagements.
No direct damage: Uruk-Hai have Toughness. Bring healing.

2: Each enemy left in staging places 1 progress at round end.
3: Place no progress by questing and the first player reveals a card.
4: Destroyed characters add progress. Complete this stage and you lose.
5: No quest phase, no threat reduction. Clear every enemy to win.

general: Mugash drops when his carrier takes damage. Pick a hero you can shield.
No enemy here takes attachments. Traps and snares are dead cards.
Each Huorn fires at the resource phase start: threat, attack, or 3 damage.
The Forest's Malice cannot be canceled. Keep a spare body.

1: Travel to Edge of Fangorn to free Mugash: 1 Huorn, 2 at 3+ players.
Time out and Mugash is shuffled away, dropping you to stage 3 regardless.
2: The timer drops you to stage 3 here too. Place the 12 progress fast.
3: No quest points. 6 progress plus Mugash on a hero sends you back to stage 2.

general: Keep Celador alive to skip stage 2. Anything leaving play damages him.
Battle or siege gives Southron Company +2 threat, +2 attack. A plain side quest shrinks it.
Ithilien Road zeroes engagement cost in staging. Clear it or all pile in.
Stage 4 adds 2 threat a round and turns siege at 37. Arrive low.

1: Finish with Celador still in staging and you skip stage 2.
3: No engagement checks here. Push the 12 progress before staging fills.
First player takes the Rangers - no auto-questing, but they can fight.
4: Threat climbs an extra 2 a round, siege at 37. Commit everything.

general: First player: never quest heroes alone. Sudden Pitfall discards a quester, uncancellable.
Threat climbs fast - five Signs of Conflict, each Doomed 2 with surge.
Goblins here have 0-3 defense. Direct damage clears staging.
Cave Torch: 3 progress on any Dark location, but exhausting it can pull an enemy.

1: Explore East-gate, First Hall, then Bridge of Khazad-dum to advance.
No engagement checks while East-gate is active - build your board.
2: Clearing all enemies advances instantly, usually faster than 11 progress.
Patrol Leader cancels a hit if the deck's top card is an enemy. Bring spare attacks.
3: Heroes collect no resources here. Bank what you need first.

general: Enemies never engage you; each in staging adds 1 threat per refresh.
No Orc War Party can be in play to win - the deck holds three.
Nothing in staging takes damage while a War Party is there. Engage it.
Sudden Assault fires on a successful quest. Don't overcommit blind.

1: Rescue Iarion is a 4-counter clock. Run out, Iarion is discarded, you lose.
Orc Rearguard caps progress at 3 a round; the quest needs 30.

general: Start under 30 threat. At 35, Evil Storm damages every character.
Swings from questing to combat - build for both, not either.
Travel every round. Parked locations pile threat into staging.
Misty Mountain Goblins strip quest progress on attack or shadow.

1: Won't clear while a Hill Troll is in play: 9 hit points, 6 attack.
8 points are the easy part. Build your board before you take them.
2: No engagement checks, but you may each take an enemy. Do it - stage 3 is worse.
16 points, plus an extra encounter card each quest phase. Bring willpower.
3: Staging stops. You win once no enemies remain in play.
Advance with defense ready: 2 cards per player hit staging at once.

general: Doom, Doom, Doom starts on 10, -1 per quest phase. Your Balrog timer.
The Balrog is indestructible until The Great Bridge strips its keywords.
Moria Orc offers to speed the timer. Take the extra encounter card.
The landed Balrog attacks for 8 each quest phase. Keep chumps ready.

1: Optional engagements burn a Doom token. Use ranged or staging attacks.
2: 3 resources per player, one per enemy defeated. Kill, don't dodge.
Chamber of Mazarbul blocks advancing; travel there and get Orc-chieftan.
3: Only 5 progress lands per round - at least 3 rounds here.
Explore The Great Bridge: discard a hero to damage and blank the Balrog.

general: Harad enemies staged at the end of planning go under The Black Gate.
You lose once The Black Gate holds player count plus 3 enemies.
The Cross-roads spits out one enemy per quest phase. Nine in all.
Henneth Annun active skips encounter and combat, blanks the Gate.

1: 20 progress and no facedown cards before you may travel to The Cross-roads.
Oliphaunts take at most 3 damage a round. Chip early.

general: Bring location control. Setup alone stages one location per player.
Hit staging: unengageable enemies block stage 1 and pad The Old Ford.
Don't chump with a hurt ally. Shadows damage defenders; a dead one lets the hit in.

1: Success adds an enemy next encounter phase. Match staging exactly, or clear 10 at once.
No advance while any Evil Creature is in play, engaged or not.
2: Travelling summons an enemy, but staging locations take only 1 progress a round.
Woodman Village ignores player cards. Travel, explore, free Haldan to advance.
3: Each enemy adds 5 quest points here. On arrival, staging enemies hit the first player.
Exploring The Old Ford wins outright. The 5 progress only buys the travel.

general: Main quest progress just finds the next objective-location. Park spare willpower on side quests.
Objective-locations and their guards ignore player cards. Kill or explore the hard way.
Twilight Hall gains 2 threat per resource, and a resource per Forest explored.

1: No player card can lower threat, and each engagement adds 1. Engage on your terms.
3: Advancing discards what you did not recover: guarded heroes and buried hand cards.
4: No damage on the nemesis until 8 progress. It hits the first player each round end.
Escape branch cannot finish with anyone engaged. Clearing them costs threat.

general: Barad-dur raises threat 1 per non-fellowship character a round. Run lean.
Keep heroes ready - staging, travel and questing all test Fortitude.
Staged Brake of Thorns hardens every Fortitude test. Travel to it.
The Lidless Eye x4: 10 threat on a fail, worse with the One Ring exhausted.

1: The first treachery each quest phase surges, uncancellable.
2: Quest successfully, then each passes a Fortitude test or gains an enemy.
3: 20 progress before you may travel to Mount Doom. It must be active to win.
A failed test by the first player caps this round at 5 progress.
4: No allies enter play, no When Revealed cancelled. Heroes only.
Exploring Mount Doom means one last Fortitude test. Save your boosts.

general: Dagnir is Indestructible. Discarding a Reforged Wormsbane after her last hit point wins.
The First Forge reforges Wormsbane, and joins the Caves deck after The Upper Levels.
Any Dagnir's Slave in play blocks all non-quest damage to her. Clear them first.
Each quest in the victory display adds 1 to her damage cap; at 5 she engages all.

1: Top two quest cards, bury one. Keep The Upper Levels; it leads to The First Forge.
2: Bypass these stages at end of combat until your board and Wormsbane are ready.
The Great Worm force-bypasses below 5 quests in the victory display. Clear 5 first.

general: Hideouts are immune to player cards; only willpower clears them.
Active location's Investigate scales Smoke and Mirrors and Deadly Accusations. Keep it low.
Rising Body Count: shuffle it into the Investigation deck rather than take +2 threat.
Killer Susie takes no damage while another Brigand is in play. Clear them first.
Stage 1 finds 1 Treasure per player. Spread them around.
Stone-Giants engage at 40. Stage 2 needs 16 progress - outquest them.
Galloping Boulders surge with a Stone-Giant staged. Bring cancellation.
Wind-whipped Rain wipes non-treasure attachments. Don't over-invest.

1: Take the free Treasure search. This advances straight to stage 2.
2: 2B digs out a Stone-Giant and reveals 1 per player. Survive it.
The High Pass removes 1 progress per player each round. Explore it.

general: Under 32 threat dodges Ungoliant's Spawn. Under 40 dodges Hummerhorns.
Never take an undefended attack - shadows here double up.
Don't victory-display the Spawn: one stage 3 needs it defeated.
Tactics starter deck lacks willpower. Pair it with another sphere.

1: Forest Spider starts in staging, +1 attack once engaged. Have a defender.
2: Just 2 points. Build up first - stage 3 branches at random.
3: Advance with the Spawn alive but nearly dead. Both branches need it gone.

general: Only stages 2 and 3 need a hero on the scroll. An enemy can hold it between.
Harbor Thugs engage the scroll bearer whenever his threat rises.
Milled locations add threat: 2 per Collateral Damage, 1 per Harbor Storehouse.
Pelargir Docks gives enemies +1 attack, +1 defence while active. Clear it.

1: Leaping Fish only mills with a hero on the scroll. Shed it or clear the tavern.
2: Sit on 13 progress and claim the scroll only when ready to advance.
3: First enemy each round hits the scroll bearer. Quest without it, claim last.

general: Progress caps at 5 a round, 10 if every Tamed Mumak quests.
No player card touches the Mumak; only Desert Oasis heals it. Losing it loses.
Threat in the Orcs' area feeds their progress. Clear it while level.
Being out of step with the Orcs is punished deck-wide. Stay level.

1: You pick the location added here. Desert Oasis heals the Mumak.
2: Still at 2B when the Orcs clear theirs and you lose. Advance first.
3: Same trap: clear this stage before the Orcs clear theirs, or lose.
Chieftain still at stage 2 adds an encounter card each quest phase.
4: 20 progress isn't the end - then travel River Harnen and explore all 10.
Chumping here hands the Orcs a progress token. Defend properly.

general: Kill Sahir's Ravager turn one. Its attacks burn ships worse each time.
Afford player count plus two burnt ships. Choose which to give up.
Elven Caravel burning damages every character. Travel there early.
Mithlond Harbor stops progress on staging locations. Clear it first.

1: End of combat burns the lowest Aflame ship per Corsair. Kill them first.
Dream-chaser is the timer - no travelling to it, and it burning ends the game.
2: Winning needs Sahir dead and every location at zero damage. Questing heals.
Sahir and Na'asiyah arrive with a resource per damage on the Dream-chaser.

general: Pass Gollum around. His guardian gains 3 threat each round end.
Never go undefended - the damage lands on Gollum, who has 5 hit points.
Give every player a 5+ hit point hero - Gollum's Bite deals 4 to one.
Attercop engages the guardian each round, threat aside - bring Ranged and Sentinel.

1: Stall if you must - the only stage that doesn't punish the guardian.
2: The guardian cannot quest, and one failed quest loses the game.
3: Guardian's hand is locked - pass Gollum to whoever has least to play.
4: Every enemy piles onto the guardian; clear them all to win.

general: Bring cancellation. Sleeping Sentry or Orc Ambush swings a game alone.
Ambush keys off engagement cost. Under 21 threat you are safe.
Arwen leaving play is a loss. Stage 3 bans healing - guard her early.
Orc Raiders strip 2 attachments on engaging. Run none, or cheap spares.

1: 20 points. Get healing down now - the last stage switches it off.
2: 2B hunts Goblin Gate in deck and discard. Remove it first; it whiffs.
3: A card per player on reveal, no healing, 13 points. Clear staging first.
Only healing is banned - prevention and redirection still work.

general: Keep Urdug and Tiny alive. If either is destroyed while you control it, you lose.
Tiny costs 2 threat every time he exhausts. Save him for attacks that matter.
Sneaking Off puts Urdug on a guarded location. You cannot advance without him.

1: Staging locations take no progress. Travel every round; only the active one counts.
2: Each stage 2 needs 5 progress to reach its guarded objective, plus Urdug and it in hand.
Beating one sends you to another stage 2 at random. All three fall before stage 3.
3: Quest failure adds that much progress here, not threat. At 5 Urdug escapes and you lose.
Engaging Urdug drags Tiny along. One player faces both - sentinel and ranged help.

general: Stage 1 resets threat to 0 - Secrecy and expensive heroes are live.
Durin's Bane counts as engaged with anyone at 1+ threat. At 0 he skips you.
Skip Silvans and Sneak Attack - leaving play gets punished.
Counter-spell can cancel an event and dump your hand. Go light on events.

1: Hold at 0 threat. Skip Doomed cards for a free round off the Balrog.
2: One quester is enough: the stage adds 4 progress at quest phase end.
Drop the Balrog to 0 hit points and you advance, no questing.
3: Never explore Dark Pit while the Balrog lives - its refresh action is the only win.
The Pit needs discarded printed cost above his remaining hit points.

general: Each quest phase: feed her a resource, or she hits the first player.
Resources raise her threat. Player card effects still work on her.
Bring condition removal - her poison stops a hero readying.
Ready your defender; she often attacks twice.

1: No quest points. Scry and stall - reach stage 2 built up.
2: One ally each per round. Progress caps at 4 - don't overquest.
3: 8 points with Shelob swinging. Push progress every round.

general: Never stall. Tribute to Mordor ticks each round; Power of Mordor is 5 cards.
No engaging Ulchor until 4 quest stages sit in the victory display.
Each advance reveals a card per player. Be ready to absorb it.
Character deaths feed Tribute to Mordor. Chumping speeds the clock.

1: Two free rounds, no questing needed. Ramp resources and board.
2: Every quest phase damages and exhausts a hero. No healing until refresh.
3: The mill spikes staging threat before you commit. Look before choosing.
4: The mill also strips matching copies from hand and board. Don't stall.
5: Progress caps at the discarded card's cost. Hold something expensive.

general: Temple Guardian holds the Gate Key: 6 attack, 10 hit points. No key, no temple.
Load the Gate Key hero: every peek costs 3 resources and an exhaust.
Ruins sour the deck: Island Watcher engages, shadows swell, resources drain.
Highest threat draws both Island Watcher and the Guardian. Stay low.

1: No quest points here. Push willpower onto staging locations instead.
The Grotto's Entrance wins at 8 progress, but flipping it recalls the Guardian.

general: Chief Turch defends without exhausting. Lose him and you lose. Heal him.
Keep your hand small. Enemies and location timers punish you per card.
Every location has a timer and an ugly effect at zero. Don't linger.
Driven Back wipes progress off staging locations. Finish one at a time.

1: Stage timer at zero drops a counter off every location. Clear them first.
2: Staging locations get +2 quest points. Travel and clear, don't chip.
Advance on a clean board: stage 3 lands the Chief, his camp, and Ravens.
3: No damaging the Chief until Raven Chief's Camp is explored: 9 progress, no player effects.
You win at end of round with the Chief in the victory display. Survive it.

general: Erelas Beacon has 2 hit points plus 3 per player. At 0 you lose.
Every enemy left in staging burns 1 Beacon hit point at end of combat.
Defend the Beacon's progress is a shield - remove it to cancel damage.
While you hold the beacon, shadow effects ignore player cards.

1: Flip Reclaim the Beacon first: faceup, staging enemies can't be engaged or hurt.
No stage 1 advance without the beacon; each push costs an exhaust or Beacon damage.
2: Refill Defend the Beacon every round - at 0 progress here, you lose.
Questing at Defend the Beacon reveals an extra encounter card.
3: Stage 3 takes the beacon back. Retake it this quest phase or lose.
Engaged enemies attack free as combat opens. Each death costs the Beacon 1.

general: At stage 1 shadow cards stay on enemies; stage 2 charges threat each.
Each event deals the Werewolf a shadow card. At three it engages and attacks.
Champion side: any Sorcery reveal heals Thaurdir 3 and gives a free attack.
Accursed Battlefield starts active - you open questing under battle.

1: Clear staging first - stage 2 charges threat per shadow card.
2: Thaurdir is indestructible until 15 progress is down. Ready an alpha strike.
He stays in staging yet attacks every player each round. Keep chumps.

general: Lake-town burns at 50 damage. Explore locations: cuts burn, banks victory points.
Don't chip at the dragon: Smaug the Magnificent moves 3 damage onto Lake-town.
Every Smaug: 20 hit points, 7-9 defense. Build up, then kill in one round.
Esgaroth Wharf, four in the deck, makes all locations immune to player cards.

1: Race through. Smaug takes at most 6 damage here - park him in staging.
2: Camp here. Quest progress can remove damage from Lake-town instead.
3: Extra card each quest phase. If damage outruns your victory points, reset to 2B in refresh.

general: Minas Tirith: 30 hit points plus 10 per player, bleeding per staged enemy.
Wraith on Wings: +1 threat, -1 engagement cost each quest phase, to 5.
Witch-king takes no damage on his Captain side - killable only at stage 5.
Allies stranded in stage 2 staging return at stage 3. Keep them alive.

1: Two planning phases, no quest, no combat. Build your board.
2: The target is the stranded allies' total cost. Enemies whittle them down.
Clear the Wraiths before advancing - staged enemies chip Minas Tirith.
3: Progress comes only from kills, equal to the dead enemy's threat.
Grond gains a resource per quest phase and hits Minas Tirith for it.
4: Questing progress becomes damage on enemies. Advance at phase end.
5: No win without Aragorn in play and the Witch-king in the victory display.

general: You cannot win here. The score is rounds you hold the line.
Cancel a When Revealed and the Mouth of Sauron hits for 6. Be sparing.
Reveals scale with resources on the Gate. Early rounds are your room.
Bring readying. Combat never stops, and everyone gains 1 threat a round.

1: Take a free card only if you can absorb its paired encounter card.
2: Failing the quest discards the active location - sometimes worth it.
Leave Slopes of Cirith Gorgor: 1 progress, but it drops a random enemy.

general: Progress is currency - effects spend it. Bank a surplus before advancing.
No stage clears until every Harad objective in play sits on a hero.
Kill Serpent Guards in staging - engaging costs progress or blanks damage.
Broken Courtyard in staging caps progress at its printed value. Explore it.

1: The objective is guarded. Free it only when ready to advance.
2: The Serpent counts as engaged with every objective bearer. Clear fast.
3: Six progress makes the Serpent damageable - then 8 hit points, 4 defense.
This stage hands one objective to the Serpent. Take it back to win.

general: If Faramir or Lord Alcaron leaves play, you lose.
Kill the Black Numenorean early: threat grows per hidden card in play.
The Cross-roads gives the quest siege. Defend until it is explored.
Most enemies engage at 5 to 20. Low threat will not save you.

1: Each combat phase: flip your hidden cards or take another. Flip early.
Use both objective allies on the final push. Stage 2 takes them.
2: Advancing flips every hidden card at once. Arrive with a short pile.
A fifth hidden card forces a flip. Bleed them off before the cap.

general: Cave Torch: up to 3 progress on a Dark location; exhausting it can pull an enemy out.
Chieftain attacks cost progress equal to the stage number - send him back to staging.
Branching Paths in staging: +1 threat to every Dark location. Pick setup locations well.

1: Kill what you can now - stage 2 zeroes engagement costs and the staging area jumps you.
2: Each enemy in play adds 4 quest points to the bar. Kill them - questing alone will not.
3: Attack Cracked Pillar as if engaged, threat as defense. Travel costs removing 4 damage.
Extra encounter card each quest phase. Bring the pillar down fast.
4: At 8 progress the Chieftain can be damaged. Bank progress, then hit at once.

general: Resources are Corsair armour: each on Sahir cancels 1 damage you deal.
Fury and Malice hits once per resource on engaged Raiders. Bring healing.
Streets of Umbar: travel there or feed a Raider 2 more resources.
Umbar Harbor active means Corsairs defend 2 higher. Clear it before killing.

3: Clear staging enemies and the active location before advancing to stage 4.
A Stormcaller left alive at stage 1 gives every Raider an extra resource.
4: Sahir can't die while another enemy holds resources, and killing one feeds him.
Shattered Monument pays every Raider a resource a round. Explore its 8 points.

general: Keep threat low. City Guard engages every player at or above its cost.
Advancing wipes the quest's resources and raises the Guard's cost.
Chip damage into City Guard early. Stage 4 needs all 20 on it to win.
Hits for 9 and ignores player card effects. Bring a repeatable defender.

1: Don't rush. Threat is low, the Guard far off. Build board and clear.
2: Bank progress early so you can bail the moment the Guard engages.
3: On arrival, taking the Guard's attack beats +5 threat near its cost.
4: Needs 20 damage on the Guard and the stage cleared. Bank damage first.

general: Resources on Gollum harden the final test; at 8 he returns to the deck.
Clear locations - Impassable Bog adds a resource per staged location.
Hold willpower back - an escape test ends every quest phase.
Avoid Fens and Mires - arriving there feeds Gollum a resource.

1: 12 points, and a party escape test ends every quest phase. Keep characters ready.
2: 3 points, but a failed capture resets you to 1B. Don't advance with Gollum loaded.
One player takes the capture test alone. Pick early, stack willpower.

general: Bring condition removal - Sorcery stacks on the quest and your heroes.
Don't chump - Dwimmerlaik and some shadows reanimate what they destroy.
All locations Underground, all enemies Undead. Trait tech always live.
Dwimmerlaik and Wraith of Carn Dum have 0 defence.

1: Strip Sorcery off the quest first - it follows you to stage 2.
2: Damage to Daechanar is cancelled and strips a Sorcery. Ping, then kill in one round.
The Altar takes no progress while Daechanar lives - swap it or location lock.
3: Split progress across the locations. Each round costs everyone 1 damage.

general: Underwater: no allies, no attachments. Bank resources for the surface.
Read the Underwater side: Dark Abyss stops attacks, Twisting Hollow blocks readying.
Cave Eels engage only while Underwater, so they pile up until you dive.
Save cancellation for Powerful Undertow. Ancient Depths cannot be canceled.

1: No advancing until three Underwater locations hit the victory display.
Alternate rounds: build on the Grotto side, then dive and quest hard.
2: Only the Shrine matters: 18 progress wins, no other quest points exist.
The Shrine goes Underwater every quest phase; staying costs 5 threat a round.

general: Archery everywhere. Bring healing and allies with real hit points.
Druadan Hunter's Archery counts empty hero pools. Leave each a resource.
Leaves on Tree strips attachments you do not pay for. Lean on allies.
Glade of Cleansing gives each Wose Archery 1, stacking with the rest.

1: Build here. Stage 2 forces Archery onto allies, stage 3 drops the chief.
2: Archery must hit allies first. Keep allies in play, heroes stay clean.
Ready a hero before advancing. No ally can defend Dru-buri-Dru's 5 attack.
3: No win without Dru-buri-Dru in the victory display, where characters get +1 willpower, +1 defense.
Willpower attacks now: progress goes on enemies, then the quest when they die.

general: Setup mills your deck to the first ally. Run enough or bury half of it.
Capture strips every token and attachment. Don't over-invest.
Threat creeps up, and Mines of Cirith Gurat caps each reduction at 1.
Most locations only bite from staging. Travel every round you can.

1: No advance until every captive is free, and each rescue reveals a card.
2: Two rounds with nobody engaged, on top of the 15 progress.
Progress raises staging enemies' engagement cost. They take no damage there.
3: Advancing costs each player a hero, stripped bare and captured.
On arrival every non-guarding enemy engages at 0 cost. Thin staging.

general: Drawing feeds this deck - enemies and locations grow on every draw.
Stage 2 strips Item and Mount attachments. Build with other traits.
Hold allies in hand. Stage 2 discards all but one in play.
Active location sets your draw: Plains of Enedwaith stops it, Hithaeglir Stream doubles.

1: Old South Road eats an extra time counter each refresh. Clear it early.
Stall until the board is clean. Stage 2 takes items, mounts, allies.
2: One round only, ending after combat with a fresh Boar Clan enemy on you.
3: Lose a hero and you lose. Chump with allies, heroes off the block.
You win if time runs out and the final attacks kill no hero. Engagements burn time.

general: Cost 2 or less feeds enemies, shadows and the Shrine.
Calphon leaving play loses the game. He has 1 defence, 3 hit points.
Track which islands you peeked at - a second look costs 4 progress.
Lush Jungle in staging: every character loses 1 attack and ranged. Clear it.

1: Exploring locations advances you - each adds its printed quest points.
Making an Uncharted location active spawns another Lost Island.
2: Only Shrine to Morgoth wins, and advancing reshuffles the islands. Peek first.
The Shrine flip exhausts every 2-cost ally and gives each player an Undead enemy.

general: Kill 5 enemies per player to load The Heroes' Defense and put Urdug in reach.
Urdug gains 2 defense per other enemy in play. Clear the board first.
He takes no damage until he has attacked that phase. Take the hit, then hit back.
Gate of Gundabad in staging voids kills for The Heroes' Defense. Clear it first.

1: The Assault counts staging enemies at end of round. Engage them off the count.
2: Now every enemy attack feeds the Assault. Kill first; Feint effects buy rounds.
3: Every enemy, engaged or not, feeds the Assault each round. Lose at 8 plus 8 per player.

general: Setup buries 8 cards under each of 4 side quests and the quest deck.
Clearing a Storm the Castle quest gets those cards back. Go fast.
Chump blocking spends cards you cannot replace.
Each side quest hides a face-up Power of Mordor card. Pick order by it.

1: Past 3 progress you cannot quest here. Only Castle side quests remain.
Clears at end of round only, with 3 Castle quests in the victory display.
2: Damage on Ulchor caps at progress here. Both need 12, so quest first.
Arrival triggers an Ulchor attack on everyone. Have blockers ready.

general: Loot arrives only through Discover. Always keep a location worth travelling to.
Each Loot you hold gives Fram's Shade +1 to all stats and a shadow card per attack.
Crypt Stalker fights at the tens digit of threat. First player under 30 defangs it.
Forgotten Crypt puts a discarded Loot back on an enemy. Save one for the last piece.

1: 6 progress and 1 Loot in hand to advance. Travel early and often.
2: 12 progress and 2 Loot. Each quest phase: 2 threat each, or a new staging location.
3: Don't kill Fram's Shade before The Cursed Tomb; only then is he worth victory points.
All 3 Loot to reach the Tomb; arriving gives the Shade a free attack on everyone.

general: Locations win this, not questing - every Emyn Muil location has victory points.
Stay under 35 threat. Orc Horse Thieves gain +1 attack per staged location.
Pack location control and treachery cancel - Rockslide deals 2 to each quester.

1: Advance at 20 victory points, with every Emyn Muil location explored.
Keep a location in staging - with none, the quest phase's first treachery surges.

general: A Clue falls off its hero on damage. Never put one on your defender.
Each Clue in play gives Hunters from Mordor +2 attack and threat.
With a Clue out, defend everything - their shadow deals 3 to each Clue-bearer.
The Old Ford's threat equals allies in play. Swarm decks feed it.

1: Collect Clues now - each needs its guard cleared and a won quest.
2: An extra card hits staging before you commit. Clear locations first.
3: A player with no Clue-bearing hero cannot quest.
Lose every Clue and you drop back to 2B. Spread them across players.

general: Pillage mills you out and Captain of the Haven eliminates you for it. Bring recursion.
Every Pillage Corsair has an extra penalty for discarded events. Run few, or filter them.
Archery is everywhere here. Get healing or damage prevention out early.
Slave Ship, Corsair Skirmisher and Corsair Warship all defend at 4+. Bring defense reduction.

1: Clear staging before advancing - stage 2 wants combat characters, not questers.
Sink the Corsair Warship now - in staging it can't be damaged and throws Archery 4.
2: Raise threat 4 to cancel a Dreadnaught attack. Nothing else you have touches it.
Damage caps at 5 per player a round; your Elite Corsair blocks attacks until it dies.

general: No stage has quest points. Progress filters the Caves deck at stage 2, buys attacks at stage 3.
Exploring the active location sends Fire-drake to staging to attack all. Have blockers.
Fire-drake: 17 hit points, 7 attack, no non-Dragon attachments. Traps won't hold it.

1: Progress is dead. Advance on 3 victory-point locations in the display, all Caves deck.
2: Fire-drake cannot be hurt yet. Spend the stage clearing every other enemy.
Dragon Hoard going active advances you. Spend 5 progress after questing to dig.
3: Each attacker declared against Fire-drake costs 1 progress or is cancelled. Few, big.
Dragon Hoard in play, Fire-drake takes no damage. Burn its 7 quest points first.

general: Lose a Captive ally and you lose. Immune to player effects - no healing.
Only the engaged player fights a Warden, and Ulwarth bars allies. Bring a defender.
Archery and chip damage are constant. Bring healing and tough allies.
Heal before the quest phase. Working Fields blocks healing from staging.

1: Travel to a Camp fast. Each left in staging adds threat every round.
Leave the last Warden nearly dead. Stage 2 revives those in the victory display.
2: Questing with no Warden engaged reveals an extra card. Keep one on you.
Quest points scale +10 per player. Bank progress, then kill the Wardens.

general: You start with no heroes - one objective-hero and 2 resources.
Your first card each phase ignores resource match. Splash freely.
Sauron's Enforcers scale with the stage and hit at every round's end.
Undefended damage hits your captured heroes in staging, not your board.

1: One good quest ends this stage and returns a hero. Buy willpower, not value.
2: Five progress returns a second hero. Push straight through.
3: Each hero left in staging is bolted to an Orc immune to player cards.
Kill the guarded Orc to advance - it has +1 to every stat.
4: Chieftain blocks the win, combat damage only. Non-unique Orcs engage 10 sooner.

general: Locate tests are paid from your hand. Card draw is the real defence.
Vast and Intricate wipes all progress and adds 7 threat. Pass it.
Thin the staging area - each card is another Lost effect if you slip.
Cave Torch drops 3 progress on a Dark location, but can add an enemy.

1: Locations cost 1 extra threat; a failed quest fires every Lost effect.
2: Opens with a locate test. Advance so the fullest hand is first player.

general: Setup drops 3 Scouts per player into staging. Bring combat heroes.
Chump-block Wolves from Mordor - destroying a character shuffles them back into the deck.
Crossing the Anduin: Uruk Vanguard +3 attack, two locations +3 threat, Massing at doomed 3.
Every Snaga Scout engages the lowest-threat player. Low threat is no shield.

1: Clear the setup swarm first - stage 2 caps you at one card from hand per round.
2: One card from hand per round. Build up first, or bring effects that skip playing cards.
3: Each quest phase costs a hero or Ranger of Ithilien. Only 1 quest point - quest hard, leave.
4: Witch-king in staging: -1 willpower per character. 3 threat after his attack keeps him engaged.

general: Each stage flip, the opposing team picks from the top 5 - uncancellable When Revealed.
Setup gives each hero a resource. Spend it; stage 1 is your calmest round.
Chamber of Mazarbul hits staging when the Watcher dies; no travel there before 3B.
Every stage 3 ending needs the Chamber explored or every enemy dead.

1: 5 progress surfaces the Watcher, untouchable below it. Bank spares - he can be sunk again.
2: Every second stage: 20 progress. Hold attachments past the flip; Narrow Paths takes one each.
3: Drums in the Deep needs no enemy in play; the other two need the Chamber explored.

general: To the Tower is a loss clock: 10 progress on it ends the game.
No quest points - stages end when their Captain dies. Use side quests.
Every version of Faramir is removed from the game at setup.
Morgul Bodyguards soak damage aimed at a Captain. Clear them first.

1: Murzag reveals a card per attack; enemies arrive engaged. Stop him.
2: Alcaron attacks again on a blank shadow. Each attack ticks To the Tower.
3: The Nazgul takes only 1 per hit. Bring repeatable pings.
Arriving reveals a card per player. Expect a staging spike.

general: You can't kill a Mumak. Damage only lowers its Capture bar.
A Mumak takes at most 3 damage a round. Don't overcommit attackers.
Bring condition removal - Strangling Python and Terrible Fever both stick.
Line up a defender who survives a 6 attack before flushing one out.

1: Exploring a location only shuffles a Mumak in - you still must draw it.
Explore no more than you need - spare Mumakil haunt stage 2.
2: Whittle one Mumak at a time - Capture checks read remaining hit points.
Travel every round. Questing with no active location adds an encounter card.

general: Leave Items home. Sinking Bog weakens anyone carrying one.
Traps are dead cards - only Neekerbreekers take attachments.
Every stage advance raises threat. Nalir adds more each refresh.
Kill the Marsh-dweller before stage 4 - it returns healed, resources stripped.

1: Setup: Sinking Bog is 1 threat, Hidden Eyot repays 2 time counters.
2: 13 progress in 3 rounds or you rotate to another stage 2 and gain threat.
3: Each new stage 3A heals the Marsh-dweller. Burst it down.
4: No progress needed. Keep a side quest active - Shifting Marshland drains it instead.

general: Nothing punishes lingering. Build the board before the goblins arrive.
Spiders of Mirkwood: +1 attack per character you have exhausted. Chump-block after questing.
The Eaves of Mirkwood shuts off cancellation while active.
Goblin Troop takes no attachments; other engaged Goblins get +1 attack, +1 defense.

1: No forced effects. Clear locations and finish side quests before advancing.
2: A Goblin Trail must reach the victory display; exploring one also adds 6 quest progress.
3: Locked while Goblin Troop lives, and it hits for 5. Bring a defender or chumps.

general: Stage 2 loops until locations worth 5 victory points per player are in the display.
Old Man Willow attacks remove a victory-display location and add its points to your threat.
Grasping Root's engage damage counts victory-display locations - prefer fewer, richer.
Withywindle is immune to player cards and blocks the win. Only willpower clears it.

2: Quest progress is wasted - victory points are the gate. Explore locations.
Wall of Trees soaks progress before any reaches the quest. Clear it first.
3: Old Man Willow is Indestructible. Win on 18 progress plus Withywindle explored.
Active Withywindle adds an extra encounter card each quest phase. Explore it fast.

general: An engaged Undead stops that player reducing threat. Clear them fast.
Bring location control - one cleared a round stops the Mire effects.
Traps backfire: at the last stage an engaged Undead freezes quest progress.
Setup reveals your location, not adds it - skip Shifting Quagmire's surge.

1: No advance without Smeagol. Attacking Gollum flips a card whose threat boosts his defense.
2: No progress on staging locations. Travel - 4 must reach the victory display.
3: One engaged Undead blocks all progress, and this stage wants 24.

general: Phantom turns enemy damage into threat. Chump blocking buys nothing.
Stage 2's quest points equal the highest player's threat.
Overcome by Fear locks threat, +1 a round. A fellowship resource sheds it.
Cards entering play outside the planning phase dodge the 1 threat tax.

1: Your hand is discarded at the end of this planning phase. Spend it.
Extra hero resources cost 3 threat - and stage 2 scales off threat.
2: Pay 1 threat each planning phase or play nothing. It lengthens the stage.
Threat cannot fall below where you started - extra reduction is wasted.
3: The Stone costs 5 progress off this stage plus an Oathbreaker per player.
The Stone strips Oathbreakers' Phantom and 20 engagement. Real damage, at once.

general: Willpower keeps characters alive - a defender with 1 dies to a Snowstorm shadow.
Winning needs 5 victory points - explore the unique locations.
Freezing Cold stops a hero questing; a second copy discards him.
Arwen leaving play loses the game, and she has 2 hit points.

1: No Snowstorms yet. Bank victory points and side quests.
2: The 11th progress discards the active location unscored. Score them first.
No travelling to Caradhras. Use location control before it goes active.
3: Snowstorms return and 0 willpower kills. Commit after staging to dodge -1.

general: Each engaging enemy damages the active location, whose effects scale with it.
Travel is compulsory each round. Pick the one that hurts least explored.
Eregion and Bitter Cold both eat allies. Load up heroes instead.
These locations bill you when explored. Removing one from play skips it.

1: Choose: shuffle in Lust for the Ring, or 5 threat each. Under 30 dodges the Warg Chief.
2: Redhorn Pass starts active; exploring it deals its damage to your characters.
3: New locations arrive damaged. Push on - the Watcher waits at stage 4.
4: The Watcher holds the Ring-bearer. Six damage frees him; Doors of Durin needs him.
Nine damage on Doors of Durin loses the game; every engagement adds one.

general: Kill enemies on arrival. Easterling treacheries attach and grow them.
Direct damage pays. Kill in staging before enemies ever engage.
Advance with a clear board. Arrival adds one enemy per player.
River Running in staging blocks optional engagement. Enemies pile up.

1: Each resource on Easterling Pursuit adds staging threat. Recount first.
2: Progress caps at 5 a round while anyone is engaged. Clear, then burst.

general: Last stage: an empty hand eliminates you, yet each draw heals Saruman and buys an attack.
Saruman cannot be killed or moved. You cannot win while he has hit points.
Machines of Isengard fires the active location's Wizardry effect.
Grima engages at 1 and reshuffles after his attack. Kill him before it.

1: No draw, no resources, no questing. Each round adds a card to the advance.
Rousing an Ent: hero willpower vs a discarded card's threat. Unclaimed Ents leave.
2: No progress needed: each non-unique location explored adds 1 damage; 5 advances.
Saruman and Orthanc sit in staging all stage. Bring willpower.
3: Travel to Orthanc to reach Saruman; exploring it cancels that phase's progress.

general: Loot gates every stage but angers the deck: Old Stone Troll loses 10 engagement cost per Loot.
Advancing clears Stalking the Ruins and sets Naurlhug aside - it resets the dragon clock.
Naurlhug's attack deals damage equal to resources on Stalking the Ruins. Don't let them stack.
Abandoned Mine blocks progress on every other staging location. Clear the Mines first.

1: Find the Keys of Belegost before advancing - they route you past 2A and the Lurker.
2: On 2A the Lurker must reach the victory display: 12 hit points, max 4 damage a round.
3: All three routes force travel every round; your Loot decides stage 4 or another loop.
4: Naurlhug takes no damage until his Lair reaches the victory display. Explore it first.

general: Both Goblin foot soldiers get +2 attack when unblocked. Always defend.
Plundered Armoury gives enemies +1 attack from staging. Travel or clear.
Goblin Tunnels strips a progress per Goblin revealed. Travel to stop it.
Defend with heroes - a shadow discards a defending ally, attack still lands.

1: The Book quests unexhausted, never attacks. Best on a high-willpower defender.
2: Each round adds enemies after staging. Budget willpower for wave two.
2B removes the Book - that hero can attack again but exhausts to quest.

general: Every enemy in play costs Annuminas 1 strength at end of round.
Buy every Dunedain of Annuminas: 1 resource for a 2/2/3 Ranged Sentinel.
Vanguard of Carn Dum in staging caps you at 5 progress a round.
Most enemies steal progress on engage or attack. Kill them fast.

1: Stage 1 always runs 4 rounds. Bank 10 progress: +10 city strength at end of round.
2: Each Host of Angmar in the victory display cuts 10 off stage 2's 50 points.
Leave a weak enemy in staging: its top attacker hits all each quest phase.
3: Kill Battering Ram first: it blocks progress, and its city damage climbs.
Lieutenant takes no damage until stage 3 has 10 progress. Quest, then kill.

general: Explore all 3 Battlegrounds in stage 1 - each skips a later stage.
A Battleground destroyed by damage is wasted: no victory points, stage stays.
Save the Banks first: it cracks at 3 damage, the Citadel at 11.
Encounter damage aims at Battlegrounds, not you. They are the clock.

1: Undefended attacks hit your weakest Battleground. Block them.
Lose the last Battleground and you advance at once, progress or not.
2: Extra encounter card every staging. Clear the last Battlegrounds fast.
3: Failing the quest costs a character, not threat. Keep a spare ally.
4: A flat 5 threat in staging, but the stage needs only 5 progress. Push.
5: 4 victory points swap siege for battle; the 3 Battlegrounds hold 6.

general: Enemies drift west toward Erebor. Abandon Erebor and you lose.
Hold the North: 1 a round, 8 wins - needs fewer enemies in play than stages left.
Every staging enemy damages that front's quest at end of round.
Cancelling an encounter effect deals 1 damage to the eastmost quest.

2: Easterling Supply Camp deals 1 a round; explore it to heal 2 on Eastern Defenses.
3: Exploring Esgaroth as active location spares Riverlands until next round.
4: Quest successfully at Dale: 4 damage to an enemy here, or 2 to one anywhere.
If Dale falls, every player discards a hero and heroes never heal again.
5: Quest successfully at Erebor early to put the Gate into play.
The Gate redirects Erebor's damage onto a hero. Keep heroes healthy.

general: Each staging step adds a Fleet resource, and that count becomes damage or cards.
With a Ship active the Corsairs swell: the Captain sheds 30 engagement and hits on arrival.
Ships are immune only in staging. Location tech works on an active one.
Pelargir Quays deals 4 damage after four rounds in staging.

1: No win while the Great Corsair Ship stands. Boarding it needs 3 Ships in victory.
Travelling to the Great Ship summons a Corsair per player, one the Captain.

general: Only the active location banks a token. Staging clears do not count.
Stages 1 and 2 have no quest points. Pour progress into side quests.
Clues are shortcuts: A Prisoner is 2 tokens, A Scrap of History 1.
Bring treachery cancellation: False Lead ends the quest phase unresolved.

1: The Fourth Star starts active. Clear and travel each round to bank tokens.
2: Roots of Mindolluin gives staging locations +2 quest points. Explore it.
3: No win while the Villain lives. Kill it before the last progress.

general: Night ticks 1 a round: 4 to Dusk, 4 more to Midnight. Win by round 8.
Under 2 willpower: the Stone blocks readying, treacheries hunt them.
If Derufin leaves play you lose. Keep him out of combat.
At Midnight take Relic from the Dark Years: its hero strips Spectral on attack.

1: Stage 1 costs 12 progress: 6 on the stage plus clearing Tarlang's Neck.
Tarlang's Neck ends the encounter phase early - skip engagements.
2: Every round costs your planning phase or hero resources. Event decks cope best.
Get Derufin at the Stone of Erech - stage 3 needs him for progress.
3: At 3A pick Whisperers: 2 attack, no when-revealed, 35 engagement.

general: Don't lower tentacle threat - a killed Creature damages the Thing by its threat.
Eye of the Beast engages at 0 and makes the Thing attack you. Kill it fast.
Tentacles engage from 13 to 23. Secrecy drowns; expect heavy late combat.
Side quests are free value - main stages offer almost no quest points.

1: No progress lands until Helm of the Stormcaller hits the victory display.
Sahir and Na'asiyah gain a resource each round out of play. Draw them early.
3: The Thing can't be engaged or targeted. Killing Creatures is your only damage.
A Ship location at 9 threat at round end loses the game. Keep tentacles spread.

general: Traps are dead - Guardians take only Keys, Spirits no attachments.
Curse of the Wild Men hits every non-unique character. Go unique.
Grim Foothills soaks progress before the active location. Doomed 2.
Cave Barrow caps the table at 5 allies. Time your swarm around it.

1: Intuition: progress only mills the deck, so camp and build.
2: Perseverance's Guardian can't be damaged. Block it and clear the Barrow.
Each Key you hold gives every Spirit of the Wild +1 attack.
3: Travel to Hallowed Circle and all three Guardians return. Kill them first.

general: The Watchers deal no damage - hits become threat. Undefended is survivable.
Stay low on threat. Stage 2 rewards enemies left in staging, and questing pulls Shagrat down.
Allies cannot attack or defend Shagrat, and he ignores non-combat damage.
Non-unique locations cannot leave staging in stage 1. They pile up.

1: No quest points - the stage ends when the Watchers die. Set up, then go.
2: 18 progress unlocks travel to Topmost Chamber, which adds Shagrat to staging.
A duplicate in staging is discarded each quest phase. Leaving one can pay.
3: 12 progress before travelling to the Watchers, now +3 threat and +3 defense.
All 12 in one phase drops Shagrat's engagement cost by 12. Have a defender.

general: Amarthiul leaving play loses the game. Never chump-block him.
Grab a Clue early: without one, shadows add attacks and make hits undefended.
Under 35 threat or Curse of the Years strips exhausted attachments.
Side quests flip to objectives, not the victory display. Leave payoffs home.

1: No questing. Clear side quests in 5 rounds; each Clue cuts 5 off stage 2.
Five rounds of setup. Ready a defender for a 6-attack wraith.
2: Overquest: Traitorous Wights and Dark Covenant remove progress.
The stage holds while Thaurdir lives. Burst him - Sorcery heals him 3.

general: Pursuit is the clock and the quest points: +1 a round, 30 loses.
Every point of pursuit added is a point you must quest through.
Do not chump block - shadow effects raise pursuit when an attack kills.
Allies cannot attack or defend against Ugluk, and stage 2 needs him dead.

1: Each enemy left in staging adds 1 pursuit after combat. Ugluk cannot be hurt yet.
2: Every enemy defeated here drops pursuit by 1. Killing is questing.
Grishnakh takes a Captive and wounds it each quest phase. Losing them all loses.

general: Losing Amarthiul loses the game. Heal him before the next attack.
Day: quest, clear locations, kill wargs. Night: just survive.
Heal up: Hunting Pack engages 1 cheaper per damaged character you control.
Main-quest progress is scarce: skip side quests, bring engagement control.

1: Night blocks progress and blanks cancellation. Quest only on day rounds.
2: Nightfall discards an ally, two at 3+ players. Don't bank on one big body.
3: Advancing brings night and Pack Leader. Clear engaged wargs or he exhausts you.
He takes damage only at 5+ progress; daybreak wipes it. Land 5, then burn.

general: 3 victory points to win - the Doors, the Watcher, your own side quests.
Doors of Durin discards titles starting S, B, T or W - 27 of 43 match.
Tentacles have 0 or 1 defence. One in play blocks engaging the Watcher.
Wrapped! discards the hero at round end. A free hero exhausts to strip it.

1: Nothing forces the pace. Build up and bank victory points first.
2: Watcher in staging costs each player 3 damage a combat phase. Win fast.
Doors of Durin passes progress on: its 5 points are easy, the 3 are not.

general: Heal constantly - damage costs willpower at stage 2 and worsens shadows.
Ice Storm hits once per quest card in play - side quests make it worse.
Cornered Orcs attack the instant they engage. Keep a defender ready.

1: No quest points. Advance by defeating enemies - player count plus three.
Exploring the active location deals an Orc card. That's your kill supply.
2: Amon Forn blocks the win and ignores player cards. Explore its 6 points.
Savage Counter-attack's tokens are a life clock. Take the extra encounter card.

general: Each Dragon Sign gives Cold-Drake +1 defense and every hatchling +1 attack and defense.
Cold-Drake takes combat damage only, no attachments. Direct damage and traps fail.
Travel to Creature Den to fetch a Dragon Sign. Keep one in staging for later.
Ready characters before staging. Heavy Snow kills readying for the round.

1: 6 progress and a Dragon Sign in the display. Bank a second; stage 3 wants three.
2: 6 damage a round against 18 hit points: three full combat rounds, plus 3 progress.
3: The drake heals 3 damage each end of round while hiding. Two or three rounds here.
4: Damage cap is now your Dragon Sign count. The drake attacks all each quest phase.

general: Travel to Rhosgobel early: 1 progress to clear, a resource and card per hero.
Rider of Mirkwood: immune to player cards, stuck in staging until 3B.
2A and 3A reveals cannot be canceled. Spend cancels elsewhere.

1: Stage 1 needs 10 progress and Rhosgobel explored, freeing the Rider.
2: A New Terror Abroad: the Rider hits player 1 each quest phase. Bring Sentinel.
3: Return to Rhosgobel caps Rider damage at your progress. Quest, then kill.
You pick the Dungeons' captive and all its tokens go. Offer a damaged hero.

general: If Mendor ever leaves play you lose. Never chump-block with him.
Traveling to Spider Den gives the other team a free enemy. Time it.
2A and 3A reveals cannot be canceled. Spend cancels elsewhere.
Keep threat low: a stage 3 option's quest points equal the top threat.

1: Stage 1 needs 10 progress and Spider Den explored - player 1 gains Mendor.
2: Every 2B caps progress at 5 a round, 10 if Mendor quests. Escort him.
3: Escape from Taur-nu-Fuin adds a location each quest phase. Bring location control.
Elvenking's Halls: 10+ progress a phase reveals a card; threat drops 1 a round max.

general: Never spend a time counter - running out adds 2 encounter cards per player.
20 cards leave your deck at setup. Build consistent, pack discard recursion.
A Mountain location per player at setup. Bring willpower and location control.
Orc Territory: quest successfully and every engaged Orc attacks.

1: Methedras is the mildest opener at 2 threat - don't make it active.
2: Only a successful quest regains a time counter. Quest every round.
Every Search risks Mugash. Wait until you can beat a 7-attack Orc.
3: No progress unless Mugash is on a hero, who then never readies.
If Mugash's Guard destroys a character, Mugash returns to staging.

general: Progress lowers threat instead, so high-threat heroes cost you nothing.
Once The Empty Mug is explored, threat reduction you play leaves the game.
Valour is dead here - the quest drives everyone to 0 threat.
If Nalir leaves play you lose. Bring healing or damage cancellation.

1: Don't stall. Each time-out drops everyone's elimination level by 10 for good.
2: All progress goes to The Crossing at Tharbad: 10 plus 2 per player.
Chumping costs 2 threat per character lost. Bellach need not die.

general: Setup cuts every deck to 40. Your deck is your life total - cut draw.
Each quest card in play mills one more card a round. Clear side quests.
Bring recursion, not draw. No event shuffles your discard back in.
Torech Gorgor Patrol caps progress at 5 a round and attacks on engagement.

1: 25 progress, no other gate. Clear side quests first - stage 2 adds one.
2: Rush it. 25 progress, nothing else, and the deck timer never slows.
An empty deck only eliminates at end of round, so a spent deck can win.

general: Staying on course skips a stage 2 each advance - four become two.
Rough Waters in staging cancels your first wheel icon. Clear it.
Leave traps at home - Ship enemies can't have attachments.
Swarm cheap allies - you need bodies for questing and sailing.

1: Don't linger. Scouting Ship engages at 35, at 20 off-course.
2: Only 2-6 progress here. One strong quest phase clears any of them.
The penalty only fires off-course. Win the sailing test.
3: Two ways out: sink every Ship enemy, or 10 progress on course.
To sink the Ship enemies, stop sailing and keep attackers ready.

general: Under 23 threat no Troll engages you - you pick the fight.
Sacks never attach to Gandalf. He works on while others are bagged.
Troll Cave: Key on Bilbo plus 5 Baggins resources - 2 with the Purse.
Kill Tom first: with him in play only one character may attack a Troll.

1: Only 7 quest points. Stall - rush and you meet three Trolls unready.
2: Progress discards encounter cards instead. Empty the deck to advance.
Trolls slip back to staging each combat unless you pay 1 threat.
3: Treasures only come if Troll Cave reached the victory display.

general: Player cards cannot progress staging locations. Cut location control.
The race is location count, yours versus staging. Both stages gate on it.
Ulchor hits for 6 and the deck surges at everyone. Bring defence.
Losing a character hands locations back. Keep the holder out of combat.

1: Explore the active location and Ulchor offers a staging location or attack.
Progress alone won't advance you. Out-hold staging on locations too.
2: Arrival takes each player's top-threat location and adds an engaged enemy.
The Gate needs 12 progress here and a location lead. Then hold it.

source: strategy tips written by this project after reading the Vision of the Palantir quest spotlights (https://visionofthepalantir.com/); summarized, never reproduced, and every claim re-checked against the compiled card data
